name: AP_TERMS_B
description:
AP_TERMS_B stores header information about payment terms you define. You need one row for each type of terms you use to create scheduled payments for invoices. When you enter suppliers or invoices, you can select payment terms you have defined in this table. Each terms must have one or more terms lines.
This table corresponds to the Payment Terms window.

columns.name: TERM_ID
columns.description: A unique identifier for the payment term.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if term is enabled

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: START_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.description: Date from which payment term is valid

columns.name: END_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.description: Date after which payment term is invalid

columns.name: DUE_CUTOFF_DAY
columns.description: Used for proxima terms only, day of a month after which Oracle Payables schedules payment using a day after the current month

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: Specifies the type of payment terms.

columns.name: RANK
columns.description: Unique rank to rate invoice payment terms against purchase order payment terms in accordance with Prompt Payment Act
